_about: Defaults for the research toolchain (scripts/research/*.mjs). Every value can be overridden by the environment: RESEARCH_LLM_BASE_URL, RESEARCH_LLM_MODEL, RESEARCH_EMBED_BASE_URL, RESEARCH_EMBED_MODEL, RESEARCH_API_KEY, RESEARCH_ROOT. Any OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint works for llm; any Ollama (/api/embed) or OpenAI-compatible (/v1/embeddings) endpoint works for embedding. Nothing here names a machine.

embedding.query_instruction: Given a plain-language situation or research question, retrieve the most relevant evidence-based findings, mechanisms and research passages
embedding.overlap_instruction: Given a section of a research report, retrieve findings that state the same guidance

evidence_domains._about: Used by card.mjs to suggest an evidence label from a document's works-cited list. Primary = peer-reviewed venues, preprint servers, standards, official docs. Everything else counts as web.
